request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, cello, hopeful and reverent, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Has He forgotten to be gracious?
Has He shut off His mercy in anger?
I said this is what wounds me deeply
That the right hand of the Most High has changed

[Pre-Chorus]
But I will remember the deeds of the Lord
I will remember your wonders of old
I will meditate on all your work
And consider all your mighty deeds

[Chorus]
Your way, O God, is holy
What god is as great as God?
You are the God who works wonders
You made your strength known among the peoples

[Verse]
With your arm you redeemed your people
The descendants of Jacob and Joseph
The waters saw you, O God
The waters saw you and writhed

[Pre-Chorus]
The very depths were shaken in awe
I will remember your wonders of old
I will meditate on all your work
And consider all your mighty deeds

[Chorus]
Your way, O God, is holy
What god is as great as God?
You are the God who works wonders
You made your strength known among the peoples

[Bridge]
Your way, O God, is holy
What god is as great as God?
Your way, O God, is holy
What god is as great as God?

[Chorus]
Your way, O God, is holy
What god is as great as God?
You are the God who works wonders
You made your strength known among the peoples

[Outro]
Your way is holy
What god is as great as God
